item.title: Stop Shopping
item.description:
I learned of Reverend Billy and the Church of Stop Shopping on my second trip to Burning Man (wow, was it really 2003?), and I instantly knew that this was a congregation for me.

Here’s a sample of some of their work:

Their message resonated with me fully, which probably had something to do with me being raised in a very Irish Catholic home. Like, go to every mass during Holy Week type of Irish Cahtolics. Anyway, my mom detested the consumerism that came along with Christmas, and over the years, that definitely trickled down to me.
